meta.name: English Premier League
meta.notice: Fixtures and results come from a free multi-source pipeline. Attack and defense ratings are fitted from 1,520 completed matches using a Bayesian state-space Poisson model. Polymarket season-winner and exact 1X2 match prices are displayed as an independent comparison when an exact market is available. They are normalized within their event for like-for-like comparison and never used as a model input.

sources.purpose: independent EPL historical results and current schedule

backtest.method: time-ordered holdout; latest matches and current preseason seeds excluded before fitting
backtest.limitations: This is a lightweight match-outcome holdout, not a complete season-title calibration study. Current preseason seeds and Polymarket data are excluded. It is intended to catch large regressions during automated rebuilds.

match_markets.note: Only exact three-outcome match-result markets are accepted. Polymarket normally lists games near kickoff, so later fixtures may show no market.

sanity_checks.note: Match-market checks are informational and never change model probabilities.
Sanity checks never feed Polymarket prices into the Bayesian model.

market_comparison.season_winner_prices: Prices come from the configured exact competition-winner event and are normalized within that event when the contract set is sufficiently complete.
market_comparison.match_prices: A match comparison is published only for a date-verified, full-match home/draw/away market that passes the matching safeguards.
market_comparison.edge_definition: Bayesian probability minus normalized Polymarket probability

preseason_calibration.last_fitted_state: The fitted time axis ends at the last completed match.
